shopkeeper.name: Rowan
shopkeeper.greeting: Welcome to the village. I am Rowan, the shopkeeper. We can talk about farming or fishing, or you can open the shop.
shopkeeper.return_greeting: Good to see you again. What would you like to talk about today?
shopkeeper.goodbye: See you around the village. Take your time and enjoy your day.

reactions.first_harvest: Your first harvest! You can sell your {item} here or use it in the kitchen.
reactions.harvest: Your {item} harvest is in. Keep some for cooking, or sell it here.
reactions.first_cooking: You made your first dish, {item}. Open your inventory when you want to use it.
reactions.cooking: You made {item}. Check its effect in your inventory before using it.
reactions.first_fishing: Your first catch! You can sell your {item} here or keep it for a recipe.
reactions.fishing: You caught {item}. You can sell fish here or keep them for cooking.
reactions.fishing_miss: No catch this time. Follow the water sound and try another spot when you are ready.
reactions.tool_broken: Your {item} broke. Open the shop to buy a replacement before trying again.
reactions.first_mining: Your first mineral, {item}! You can sell minerals or keep them for research.
reactions.mining: You collected {item}. Check the research costs before selling your minerals.

farming.empty: Start by planting a seed in an empty plot. Water your crops, then sleep to help them grow.
farming.needs_water: Some of your crops still need water. Water them before you sleep so they can grow.
farming.ready: You have crops ready to harvest. You can sell them here or use them in your kitchen.
farming.growing: Your crops have water. Let them rest overnight, then check their growth tomorrow.

fishing.without_rod: You will need a fishing rod from the shop. At the lake, follow the water sound to find a fishing spot.
fishing.with_rod: You have a fishing rod. At the lake, move toward the water sound, then tap to cast. You can sell your catch here.
